full_page.content:
Page 52 Cont.
Wm Szpoywa - 33 - in Eloise - believed to be possessed - insane - of late showing improvement % prayers - Enrollments a novenas.
Robert Kirsjes - 5 - Grand Rapids - Knocked down. This happened March 9 - One Eye completely closed.
Mrs. Clare Schumacher - 46 - (Ser. Apr. 21) hopeless cancer of thigh- bone .... lately it seems all over body, even in her tongue.
Page 53 Mary Doyle - 38 - Univ. Hospital Ann Arbor - tuomer on left lung ... T. B. Very little hope .... Consultation Charity.
Mrs. Cath Cannizzaro - nerveous breakdown
Harry Simpson .... about 40 in San. nerv ...
Anthony Fisher - 28 - undesirable company . .. Donald Wiebiceht - 6 - Lutheran - very sick. .
June 7 Today little Eleven - mo. old little Sylvia Levandowski - seemingly hoplessly dying with spinal maningitis - in spasims during two first blessings with Cross-relic, relaxed and almost smiled all through 3rd 10th Blessing. 8 P.M. Parents here To-day - Child recognized her father 18 Not so well to-day .... + 28th.
Ruth Schneider - 29 - scrupolus since 16.
Robert Emmett Morrissey - 20 - Candidate for C.S.S.R. - asks for prayers for God's guidance. September 6th, 1922 or '23, swallowed lye .... for 30 months could not take any nourishment except artificially I ...... 1951 same R. E. Morrissey was enrolled in Ser. M.A. and became a novice with the Redemporits.
Page 54 June 15th Frank Kosin - 12 - carried in To-day unable to walk or stand - no sleep - very little nourishment - Parents going to H. Comm'n 3 times a yr. promise weekly for at least 3 months if boy recovers.
Mary Jankowski - 46 - Hodgkin's disease - form of fatal cancer. Drs. give her one month to live ...
